answer: Proof-of-effort transcript chaining. Each new identity must submit a solved task chain whose final answer is derived from a secret seed issued only after the prior answer is verified, making replay impossible across agents. The system keeps a public garden of past seeds, so any duplicate chain is rejected at the horizon of its first reused step. A copied answer fails verification because the seed binds to the agent's prior transcript, forcing attackers to redo full computation per identity, and the whisper of a shortcut spreads only to invalidate itself.
